question: Calculate the total assignable and non-assignable area for each building by summing up the respective areas of all its floors. For each building, list the building name, building number, total assignable area, total non-assignable area, and total room count, sorted in descending order of the total assignable area.
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "floors_per_building" AS SELECT "building_key" AS "BUILDING_KEY", "floor" AS "FLOOR", "assignable_area" AS "ASSIGNABLE_AREA", "non_assignable_area" AS "NON_ASSIGNABLE_AREA" FROM beaver."fac_floor";
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "buildings_directory" AS SELECT "building_number" AS "BUILDING_NUMBER", "building_name" AS "BUILDING_NAME", "building_key" AS "BUILDING_KEY" FROM beaver."buildings";
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "rooms" AS SELECT "building_key" AS "BUILDING_KEY", "room" AS "ROOM" FROM beaver."fac_rooms";

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT 
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  b.BUILDING_NUMBER AS building_number,
  a.total_assignable_area,
  a.total_non_assignable_area,
  COALESCE(r.total_room_count, 0) AS total_room_count
FROM tmp_areas a
LEFT JOIN tmp_rooms r USING (BUILDING_KEY)
LEFT JOIN buildings_directory b USING (BUILDING_KEY)
ORDER BY a.total_assignable_area DESC
S:
# Aggregate floor areas and room counts by building, then join to building directory for names
floors_sql = '''
SELECT 
  BUILDING_KEY,
  SUM(COALESCE(ASSIGNABLE_AREA,0)) AS total_assignable_area,
  SUM(COALESCE(NON_ASSIGNABLE_AREA,0)) AS total_non_assignable_area
FROM floors_per_building
GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
'''
rooms_sql = '''
SELECT BUILDING_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT ROOM) AS total_room_count
FROM rooms
GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
'''
areas_df = db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, floors_sql)
rooms_df = db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, rooms_sql)
# Register small aggregates as temp views for SQL join
db_api.register_temporary_df(user_id, chat_id, areas_df, "tmp_areas")
db_api.register_temporary_df(user_id, chat_id, rooms_df, "tmp_rooms")
final_sql = '''
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT 
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  b.BUILDING_NUMBER AS building_number,
  a.total_assignable_area,
  a.total_non_assignable_area,
  COALESCE(r.total_room_count, 0) AS total_room_count
FROM tmp_areas a
LEFT JOIN tmp_rooms r USING (BUILDING_KEY)
LEFT JOIN buildings_directory b USING (BUILDING_KEY)
ORDER BY a.total_assignable_area DESC
'''
db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, final_sql)
